'''Kainnan''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Zerist]], one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Obri]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], mostly populated by the workers of [[Dessain Mining]]. It was located at the base of [[Sokar volcano]] to get heat and energy from it, though it meant a constant threat of occasional eruptions. The government of Zerist usually predicted the eruptions and evacuated the population for the periods of volcanic activity.<ref name="Eruption" />
